problems: BLOCKER (root config, already reported by the foundation): `pnpm exec vitest run --project ui` fails: 47 of 57 ui files cannot compile because there is no vite-plugin-solid. My boot tests are plain TypeScript, but 4 of the 45 fail there because the root config has no css.include, so `?raw` CSS imports come back empty. With ui/vitest.config.ts all 406 ui tests pass.

Budget conflict: DSN-10 (ui-design-system.md, kept unchanged by visual-language-macos.md) sets the inlined boot-ui (splash, menu, panic, recovery) at 5 KB gzip or less. The measured inline set is 16.13 KB gzip (10.83 KB JS plus 5.38 KB CSS). The splash alone is 4.13 KB gzip of JS. That is well within the 60 KB boot-critical budget and at the boot spec's advisory 16 KB, but about three times DSN-10. With six screens, 5 KB is not reachable without dropping screens or design detail. The spec owners (R3 and R5) need to decide.

Found and fixed during the work: the design references and the obvious implementation use inline `style` attributes and innerHTML templates, which the production CSP (no 'unsafe-inline', security-model.md §3) and local/no-html-sinks (AGT-06) forbid. The boot screens now use an element-tree builder, set custom properties only through the CSSOM, and a test enforces both.

Found, not mine to fix: ui/src/icons/atom-logo.ts (foundation) paints the orbit, core and electron colours through `style` attributes. Under the production CSP these are blocked, so the Solid AtomLogo and the rawIcon strings may render with colourless orbits. The boot copy strips them and paints the same --pl-logo-* tokens from boot.css.

Spec inconsistencies. I implemented the choices noted here, pending an owner decision: the countdown is 5 s in boot-and-services.md §3.7 but 3 s in ui-design-system.md §3.8.2 (setCountdown(remaining, total) defaults to 5). The bar width: I used the token --pl-boot-bar-w (240 px) rather than the spec's 320 px or the design's 280 px. The identity spec's ring-and-point mark conflicts with the atom (I used the foundation's atom tree, as a single source). The panic label is 'Dump diagnostics' in the boot spec and design but 'Download diagnostics' in the UI spec. The recovery wording differs between the two specs.
Stitch returned no screens (screen.html and screenshot.png are absent for all six slugs). I followed the hand-built reference.html, reference.png and notes.md in each folder instead.

Scope not built: the boot-stall watchdog screen (SVC-18), the 'Plotinium is running in another tab' takeover, 'This page is not Plotinium', the 'Shut down' state, and the optional services rail of the verbose view (1280 px and wider). The exported h(), render(), backdrop() and logoSvg() make each of these small to add.
Other agents' in-progress files briefly failed tsc and one test (ui/src/shell, ui/src/login) during my run. They were green at the final verification. I did not touch them.

The scratchpad directory is shared by the concurrent agents. Before switching to a private ui-boot/ subfolder, I wrote shot.mjs, min.mjs, csp.mjs, gshot.mjs and gaxe.mjs at the scratchpad root.
